Task: Input a URL into an address bar and initiate navigation (e.g., by pressing Enter or clicking a 'Go' button).
Expected Result: The input field attempts to prepend 'https://' if no scheme is present. A simulated loading progress bar is displayed. Simulated web content corresponding to the URL is shown. The URL is added to a simulated browsing history.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
